items.summary: Export to HTML embeds locally readable images as base64 data-URLs so the single .html file is self-contained.

events.detail: After the export-format research the owner asked (translated from Russian: 'do we currently produce self-contained HTML? in the current implementation?'); the styled-HTML export was not self-contained for raster images — raw markdown src survived into the file.

C-SELF-CONTAINED-HTML-EXPORT implemented: the M-065 exportImages pass (stat-gated 8 MiB cap, ipcFs.readBinary, extension-mapped MIME, dedup, skipped accounting) wired into the styledHtml branch of editor.vue only; notice keys in ten locales plus min mirrors; graph M-065/V-M-065 and the DF-007 refresh; grace lint 0 errors. Uncommitted in the main checkout (branch feat/fix009-session-recovery); the commit lands through the safety gate on owner instruction.

Two clean passes on the spec (verdict approve after fixes) (Pass A correctness/GRACE contracts, Pass B security/verification/UX) caught the false readFile-binary assumption and fixed it to readBinary before implementation. Implementation gates: unit 19/19, component 6/6 plus printService neighbor 3/3, e2e 4/4 on chromium (byte-identical embed through mt_fs_stat + mt_fs_read_binary, never the UTF-8 mt_fs_read; remote URL untouched), print-export.spec.ts regression green, npm test 4824 passed (the single remaining suite failure is the parallel session's unresolved merge-conflict marker in release-readiness.test.js).
